ai_summary: Axis Bank reported a strong Q2FY27, with net profit surging 38% year-over-year, driven by robust growth in deposits (21% YOY) and advances (23% YOY), alongside significant improvements in asset quality with Gross NPA declining to 1.16%. While the bank maintained healthy core operating performance and digital leadership, a material impact to note is the decline in its CASA ratio from 40% to 36% year-over-year, which could indicate a shift towards more expensive term deposits and potentially impact future Net Interest Margins.
